messages:
kira_cs: Quick flag — Oculus Health onboarding: their patient-summary route shows a fat tail. p95 ~450ms, p99 ~1.1s, avg tokens ~1.1k. Renewal check in 12 days. Any low-risk pilot ideas?

samir_ml: Two quick levers: 1) try int8_safe quant on a compact variant (small quality delta on summaries), 2) route token_length > 900 to a compact canary. Also enable prefix/KV cache for repeated notes. Keep it staged with auto-fallback.

evan_sre: I can stand up a 4% dedicated canary pool and apply token-length routing. Need acceptance criteria and rollback plan.

marta_success: Acceptance: p95 < 300ms AND summary_quality_delta <= 1.0% (ROUGE-L). Rollback immediately if client reports quality issues or automated checks fail.

samir_ml: Canary draft (short):

```yaml
name: oculus-compact-int8-canary
pct: 4
model: redwood/compact-med
quant: int8_safe
fallback: redwood/llm-standard
route: token_length > 900
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - summary_quality_delta
```

evan_sre: Deploying routing: {"policy":"token_length","threshold":900,"dest":"oculus-compact-int8-canary","fallback":"llm-standard"}. Provisioning 4% pool now. ops-bot will confirm.

ops-bot: Canary 'oculus-compact-int8-canary' provisioned by evan_sre. Start epoch 5860050000. Alerts configured: p95>300ms, quality_delta>1.0%, error_rate>1%. :rocket:

marta_success: I'll schedule a 20m enablement call with rachel@oculus.health Tue 09:00 PT to align on tradeoffs and capture 8-10 representative prompts. We'll add failing examples to their eval set for quick rollback tuning.

kira_cs: Plan: 1) enablement Tue 09:00 PT (marta to invite), 2) 4% canary (evan provisioning), 3) monitor 72h and collect client examples, 4) scale only if p95 <300ms and quality_delta <=1.0%. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
